$comment: R41 I1 lane row; the coordinator files it in LEDGER.json

entries.hypothesis: A bar fitted on the population it is applied to (wrong-key seeds from the six generator families that pass pf_v4_12 on the real LP2 head and are decoded by beam_v3 panel_max under panel-R36) reproduces the survivors the real sweeps produce, and every Round 36-40 best row stays below it.
entries.control_detail: 480 plants (20 x 12 registers x 2 relations) through the real chunk path: 470/480 passed the pf_v4_12 screen; every one of the 470 cleared the bar of record at N=1e6 at BOTH L=120 and L=240 (min pmax120 12.35, min pmax240 17.71 against 10.46/10.49 and 10.05/10.35). The pre-registered gate (>=19/20 in every register x relation cell) fails in two cells, LATIN keyskip1 and OE keyskip2 (18/20 each), solely through screen misses (10 plants lost to the screen: EN_KJV 1, LP1_REAL 1, LATIN 2, OE 2, CY 1, EN_HALFVOWEL 1, GREEK 1, HEBREW 1; 7 of the 10 have a skip inside the 24-rune head).
entries.threshold: Gumbel/POT bar of record at N=1e6 and at actual N (alpha 0.01); fixed in PREREG.md before the first draw

result.population: wrong-key seeds uniform over six generator families (bash 4.2 LP64, bash 4.2 ILP32, PHP mt_scale, mt_mod, php_scale, php_mod), real LP2 head, passed through pf_v4_12 at the frozen point, survivors decoded by beam_v3 panel_max under panel-R36
result.Q5: fired in the conservative direction: observed real-sweep maxima sit 0.7-2.8 SE BELOW the Gumbel-implied location (11 of 12 store x relation cells negative; R37-I2 keyskip1 -2.78, R40-B1 keyskip2 -2.80), and the null's own tail counts are 2-4 SE below exponential expectation at q99.9 / q99.97 (xi_gpd about -0.13): the exponential tail over-predicts; the GPD sensitivity bar (about 6.8-7.0) is crossed by the real stores' own maxima (7.065, 7.098), so it cannot be the bar. Bar of record = the higher of the Gumbel refit and the pooled real-sweep POT line at L=120; Gumbel refit at L=240.

rejudge.kdf_flag_withdrawn: R40-B3 KDF keyskip2 6.528 vs refit bar 7.435 at N=591 (stored null12 bar 6.342 had flagged it)

entries.coverage: 48,758,784 wrong-key heads screened (8,126,464 per family x 6); 41,149 survivor draws, 40,482 distinct (key, family) decoded at L=120 under both relations and 5,194 distinct at L=240 (floors 40,000 / 5,000 met on distinct keys); 480 plants through the real chunk path; the three real-sweep survivor stores (R37-I2 131,786, R40-B1 142,283, R40-B3 33,308 rows per relation) used as the empirical comparison; 34 best rows re-judged (R36-B1, R37-I2, R40-B1, R40-B3, R40-C1 screened families).

three_conditionals.key_space: wrong keys drawn uniformly from six generator families (bash 4.2 LP64/ILP32 orbit prefixes, PHP mt_rand four cells over 2^32 seeds); a bar for survivors of the six-family mixture, not for any generator outside them and not for the unscreened (no-prefilter) or direct-stream populations
three_conditionals.transition_model: beam_v3 panel_max keyskip1 and keyskip2 only, beam_w 400, lam_u 4, after pf_v4_12 (frozen point m=24, k=2, rel both); not the free relation
three_conditionals.adjudicator_register: panel-R36 12 registers, pmax; L=120 and L=240 on LP2[:120] / LP2[:240] (nodes only at these two lengths; no extrapolation in L)

entries.not_covered: L other than 120 and 240; the free relation; direct (non-key) families (see benchmark/bars_matched.py); unscreened populations (null12 still describes shuffled-LP2 wrong keys with no prefilter, and its bars are not made stricter by this refit); draws are with replacement (1.6 % repeat keys, deduplicated for the fit); L=240 has no real-sweep survivor rows to compare, so its bar is the Gumbel refit alone (n about 5,194, bar SE about 0.2); bars at N>=1e6 are tail extrapolations (the observed tail is lighter than exponential, so they are conservative); the 1 % family-wise level at N~1.3e5 cannot be measured empirically (it would need ~100 independent sweeps of that size).
entries.reopens_if: a sweep's survivor median or q99 departs from 2.80 / 4.76 (the population changed); a family beyond the six (for example Perl, Python MT, PHP with another seed range) is screened; the pf_v4_12 frozen point is changed; or a real sweep produces a survivor row above 9.0 at L=120 (re-decode at L=240 and re-judge against these bars).
